subject: Re; why do you love Burnout
author: BootlegGiant
body:
I'm not a big fan of the offline aspect of Burnout (shouldent say that)  but as for the online bit I would probably say that it is the best online game ever made and beats such titles as Halo, PGR, Forza, COD now dont get me wrong I Love Halo 3 and COD but online you cant beat the friendly banter you get with Burnout on other titles people will only talk to you if your good or if you get the highest kill count
